brief: An escrow-style payment platform for Egyptian freelancers: milestones, dispute windows and tax receipts.

evidence.title: Product one-pager
evidence.content: Scope: pilot with 50 users. Success: 80% of target workflows completed in-app without phone support. Constraints: launch before the semester starts; no stored card data.

evidence.title: Ops constraints memo
evidence.content: Budget covers one engineer and one designer for 3 months. All data must stay on local hosting. Support channel is WhatsApp-first; email secondary.

requirements.text: The system shall hold client funds in escrow before work starts.
The system shall release milestone funds 14 days after delivery unless disputed.
The system shall generate a PDF tax receipt containing the freelancer's tax ID per payout.
The system shall allow either party to open a dispute within the window.
The system shall show both parties the same milestone status at all times.
Payout data shall be resident on servers located in Egypt.
